name: tools-rom-hack-manager-v2-4
title: ROM Hack Manager v2.4.0
description:
Download, unzip, and patch ROM hacks all in one go!

You can search SMW and YI hacks on SMWCentral's catalogue directly from within the tool. The tool will download, unzip, and patch them automatically.

This tool also offers a simple hack-management interface:
- List hacks present in one folder
- Run hack in the emulator
- Delete a hack

For the documentation and source code, you can check out the GitHub repository.

The version listed on this page is for Windows 10 or newer. You can find the download links for macOS and Windows 7 or older on the download page.

Changelog:
- [2024.09.07]: Allow to set custom emulator path and arguments; add global setting to set a custom cookie for searches and downloads; fix search by difficulty for SMW hacks; add more search options (moderation status, sorting, misc.: puzzle); added more columns in search results (rating, length, size, etc.); added a filter to search through downloaded hacks; a few new settings.
